body.name: Executable cycle-label-preserving SC-CTFID specification
body.construction: Input is exactly \(I=(V,\mathcal X,G,S,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal R,A,B,\mathcal T,\mathcal L,\Omega,\Phi,H,K)\); \(p\) is not a numerical input, because the output is one symbolic circuit valid uniformly on the full positive feasible image. Validate, in this order, alphabet and index types, graph and source arities, table dimensions, legality bits by direct unique-solution enumeration, and equality of the supplied \(\Phi,H,K\) tables to decoder recomputation; the first failure returns \(\mathsf{invalid}\). Initialize \(\Xi\) with the unnested numerator and denominator worlds, each occurrence labeled by its original SCC, all source labels unmerged, and one root subproblem. Repeatedly pop the lexicographically least stack item and take the first applicable transition: (1) delete a contradictory event row or a duplicate assignment and perform CTFID conditional-factor cancellation; (2) restrict to the ordered source-menu ancestors of the active event; (3) split the ordered consolidated-district partition and push its children in reverse lexicographic order so the least child is processed first; (4) extract the least available regime factor whose intervention set contains the required complement; (5) if the active graph is acyclic, call CTFID with the inherited order and record its formula or acyclic certificate; (6) otherwise isolate the least original-cycle-labeled terminal, materialize its complete boundary primitive-event interface, and call \(\mathsf{SATerm}\); (7) compose returned expressions or glue a returned source-table certificate through the stored interfaces. The state measure is the multiset, under the Dershowitz--Manna extension of lexicographic order, of \(m(\xi)=(w(\xi),d(\xi),a(\xi),e(\xi),h(\xi))\) over pending items: unresolved world occurrences, unresolved consolidated districts, unavailable required regime factors, unmaterialized legal source tuples, and remaining phase rank. Each transition removes one item and inserts only items with a strictly smaller tuple; terminal CAD and Groebner tasks carry their standard finite projection-pair or leading-monomial work list as \(h\), consuming its least element at each internal transition. Branches and monomial orders are lexicographic in the fixed orders on \(V,\mathcal X,S,\mathcal R\). Final outputs are only a verified \(C\), a verified \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), \(O\), or \(\mathsf{invalid}\).
